title: Safer recipe validation and more reliable runtime recovery
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-10 strengthens recipe compatibility checks, restores DeepSeek tool calling, and makes recipe and Metrics behavior clearer during everyday operation.
changes: Run recipe-declared compatibility checks inside the exact pinned container image before downloading large model weights, with no network, GPU, host mounts, or elevated privileges.

Update the one-Spark DeepSeek V4 Flash SparkInfer recipe to a verified ARM64 runtime whose XGrammar dependency supports structured output and tool calling while preserving its 262K-token context target.
Automatically revalidate a recipe when machine or network identity changes invalidate earlier launch evidence, instead of leaving users to discover the manual Validation workaround.
Prevent validation of a different recipe while one is running, and hide removal controls for the active recipe so the interface matches the operations Cloudless can safely perform.
Show each recipe's immutable version as a prominent badge on installed, Discover, and details views so users can immediately identify the revision they are inspecting or running.
Add an opt-in authenticated Metrics API for external monitoring while keeping metrics exposure disabled by default and protected by Cloudless API permissions.
Place Activity time-range controls with the graph and remove duplicate aggregate GPU tiles while retaining per-device GPU telemetry, CPU, and system-memory information.
